lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in a grid-like formation, with primary nodes forming vertical columns posterior to the fifth gill slit and horizontal rows along the mid-lateral axis.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high intensity on the superior edge and deep shadow on the inferior edge, running parallel from the branchial region toward the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs localized within the lower two-thirds of the first dorsal fin's silhouette; the apex appears devoid of distinct patterning.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, distinct notch is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A dense concentration of high-frequency, small-diameter spots is present on the proximal dorsal surface of the left pectoral fin.
